description: EscortFox is an international directory of escort, agency, and adult venue listings organized by country and city. Listings include summary data such as location, rates, services, languages, and links back to the main website, while full contact details and galleries remain on escortfox.com.
summary: EscortFox exposes three public, unauthenticated developer/agent surfaces on its own domain: a read-only HTTP API at api.escortfox.com, a Streamable HTTP MCP server at escortfox.com/mcp, and a JSON-RPC A2A agent at escortfox.com/a2a.
